Formal Conjectures Workshop

On September 7-11 2026 there will be a Formal Conjectures workshop in central London, funded by a generous donation from Google.

What is Formal Conjectures?

DeepMind's Formal Conjectures repo is a repository of Lean formalizations of unsolved mathematical conjectures, and theorems related to them. The aim of the workshop will be to work on the repository, in particular adding new conjectures to the repository, and possibly also adding new definitions to mathlib in order to state these conjectures. There will be no talks during the workshop; people will work in small groups during the week, and people are encouraged to apply in small groups and to propose conjectures which they wish to work on. Note that the goal is not to prove the conjectures, but merely to state them.

Where do I sign up?

Please register using the google form. A warning: numbers are limited and we will not be able to take everyone. The organizers will make decisions on invites some time after applications close, which will be on Sunday 12th July at 23:59 UK time.

Signed, the organizers:
Kevin Buzzard, Yaël Dillies, Moritz Firsching, Paul Lezeau, Bhavik Mehta, Salvatore Mercuri, Eric Wieser.
Questions and discussion can take place at this link https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/524981-Formal-conjectures/topic/Workshop.20in.20London.20in.20September/near/606403039
